description.narrative: The LGRP II (Decentralization by Devolution - D by D) objective is to achieve devolution of central government roles and functions to local government authorities, and to that end transform local government authorities-(LGAs) to be competent strategic leaders and coordinators of socio-economic development, accountable, transparent in service delivery and poverty reduction interventions in their areas.

description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2013Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The programme came to almost a full stop in February 2013 when donors decided to not allow any further use of programme funding due to the findings reported by the special procurement audit commissioned by the Swedish Embassy. However, from a results perspective the mid -term review which was reported in late 2012 concluded on a very poor situation from the 15 million USD invested so far by donors (Sweden, Finland, Holland, Germany, Ireland and Japan), for example: "the program has not recorded much by way of achievement; has not addressed the needs of the intended beneficiaries; output and outcome as defined in the vision document have not been achieved; the administrative arrangement of LGRP II within the structure of LGRP II is not functioning at all; there are no proper channels of reporting; there are no coordination meetings and inadequate leadership is mentioned as the main reason; PMO-RALG itself lacks authority, integrity, strength and personality". In short a full results failure, and with mismangement and corruption by intent on top to complete the total waste of donor funding.
